title: AI CRM Deduplication & Enrichment
tagline: Clean, enrich, and route new leads before they enter your CRM.
businessOutcomes: Cleaner customer records and fewer duplicate contacts.
summary: Checks new leads against existing CRM records, identifies duplicates, normalizes company information, enriches missing fields, and prepares clean records for CRM creation.
businessProblem: Inbound leads from forms, imports, and list buys create duplicate CRM records, incomplete company data, and routing chaos — sales reps chase the same account twice or work leads with no firmographic context.
outcome: Every new lead is matched against existing records, enriched with company size and industry, deduplicated or merged, and routed to the right owner before it hits the pipeline.
expectedOutcomes: Every new lead is matched against existing records, enriched with company size and industry, deduplicated or merged, and routed to the right owner before it hits the pipeline.
whoItsFor: Teams using HubSpot or Salesforce who receive leads from multiple channels — web forms, trade shows, purchased lists, and Navigator exports.
aiInputs: New lead record: name, email, company, phone, form source
Existing CRM contacts and companies (fuzzy match fields)
Enrichment API response (Clearbit, Apollo) for firmographics
Business rules: merge vs. create, owner assignment by territory
aiOutputs: Duplicate match report with confidence score and recommended action
Enriched lead record with normalized company name, industry, size
CRM create/update payload ready for API call
Audit log of merge decisions for review
noCodeTools: Zapier: form submit → Clearbit → HubSpot create with duplicate check
Clay.com table with CRM lookup and enrichment columns
lowCodeTools: n8n: webhook on form → Apollo enrich → HubSpot search → merge or create
Make.com with OpenAI for fuzzy company name normalization
Google Sheets staging area with Apps Script dedup before CRM push
customBuildStack: HubSpot/Salesforce search API with fuzzy matching logic
OpenAI for company name normalization and match confidence
Queue with human review for low-confidence merges
implementationSteps: Map CRM fields and define match keys: email, domain, company name + phone
Connect enrichment provider (Clearbit/Apollo) for missing firmographics
Build fuzzy match rules — exact email, domain match, phonetic company name
Set merge vs. create thresholds; route ambiguous matches to review queue
Define owner assignment rules by geography, industry, or round-robin
Run in shadow mode for 2 weeks — log decisions without writing to CRM
systemBehavior: Triggers on each new lead submission or batch import — near real-time
Never auto-merges records below confidence threshold without review
Read enrichment APIs; write only approved records to CRM
Preserves original form data in audit trail
Skips enrichment for known customers to save API credits
risks: False-positive merges combine two different people at similar companies
Enrichment APIs have coverage gaps for small local businesses
Overwriting CRM fields with enrichment data can destroy rep-entered context
PII handling requires scoped API tokens and audit logging
